name: postgresql-mcp
description: PostgreSQL database operations for AI agents — query, execute, migrations, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE via FastMCP. Air-gapped, local-first, production-ready.
long_description:
PostgreSQL MCP provides secure, local-only database access for AI agents. Built for regulated industries (finance, legal, marine) where data never leaves your infrastructure.

Features:
- Parameterized SELECT queries with result sets
- DML execution (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) with row counts
- Schema inspection: list tables, describe columns/indexes/constraints
- Migration runner for schema changes
- EXPLAIN ANALYZE for query optimization
- Connection pooling (asyncpg) with configurable limits
- Structured JSON logging via structlog
- API key authentication for remote access
- Multiple transports: stdio (default), SSE, Streamable HTTP
- Runs on commodity hardware (AMD/DirectML optimized)
- Zero cloud dependencies — fully air-gapped

POSTGRESQL_MCP_TRANSPORT.description: Transport protocol: stdio, sse, or streamable-http

POSTGRESQL_MCP_API_KEY.description: API key for SSE/HTTP authentication (required for non-stdio transports)
